gen-gf-architects-daughter-manrope: Hand-drawn S curves that flare wide at both ends give Architects Daughter its loose, easygoing charm. Manrope follows in plain sans, its lowercase taller and its curves left bright and open, so text sized up a notch stays comfortable.
gen-gf-architects-daughter-montserrat: Architects Daughter writes its heading like a quick, friendly hand. Its diagonals match its stems, while Montserrat counters with oversized e and a shapes and a smooth, wire-like line that glides along beneath.
gen-gf-architects-daughter-satoshi: Loose handwriting over tall, crisp lettering. Satoshi brings a soaring x-height and an e that never squeezes shut, and that sturdy openness is what makes the whole pairing work.
gen-gf-architects-daughter-switzer: Wide-opening S curves and diagonals that echo the stems give Architects Daughter a relaxed, hand-drawn lilt as a heading. Switzer's wire-like, tall-waisted letters supply the contrast.
gen-gf-architects-daughter-work-sans: Work Sans reads modern and crisp, with its mean line set high. Against Architects Daughter's hand-drawn looseness, that tidy structure is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-arima-author: Arima arrives expressive and bold, with moderate thicks and thins and white space leaking in freely around each letter. Author, a refined serif with a slight swell on the bowls, is made for shorter reading.
gen-gf-arima-gf-bhutuka-expanded-one: BhuTuka Expanded One is a literary text serif whose curvy letters feel unclamped and slow the reading to a leisurely walk. And Arima's bolder display shapes, with only moderate stress, sit above it as a livelier counterweight.
gen-gf-arima-gf-hepta-slab: Arima's mellow thick-thin shifts and freely leaking white space give its display letters an expressive, bold personality. Hepta Slab's stretched-out, stout-stroked words make for a bookish, unhurried read.
gen-gf-arima-gf-stint-ultra-expanded: Bold and loose up top, stiff and traditional below. Stint Ultra Expanded floats each character apart like pipe cleaner, so Arima's slight thick-thin variation gets a sturdy partner to play against.
gen-gf-astloch-gf-graduate: Astloch's tightly knit strands, like twisted rope fibers, make it the most unmistakable thing about this pair. Graduate, a dignified serif with generous spacing and no stem-to-join contrast, keeps reading bookish and unhurried.
